bug_57: oldroyd_b_extrusion evaluated the Cross viscosity once at a guessed shear (dp*r/(2*L*eta0) = 6.67 1/s) and computed Hagen-Poiseuille flow with it, but the resulting wall shear was 33.9 1/s where the shear-thinning ink is far thinner - flow rate 0.213 mm3/s vs the self-consistent fixed point 0.928 mm3/s (4.36x low). Fixed: bisection solve of q = pi r^4 dp / (8 eta(4q/(pi r^3)) L), monotone with a unique root; verified against scipy brentq.
bug_58: constitutive_model claimed 'Oldroyd-B elastic stress' while returning a shear-thinning stress (stress/shear = 3.63/1.56/1.33 at shear 1/10/100). An Oldroyd-B fluid has constant shear viscosity by definition; the label now says Giesekus-family and states the distinction.
data_note: multiphysics simulator: ground truth is the module's own constitutive equations (HP/Cross fixed point vs brentq), analytic limits (1-exp(-kt) surface conversion, RK4 ODE cross-check, logistic/relaxation recomputes) and standard-model facts (Cross, Carreau-Yasuda, Oldroyd-B constant shear viscosity). Ink constants are plausible bioink values but not fitted to a specific literature dataset - documented.
